rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing (proposed Div. 11)
rules.requirement: If adopted, landlords could not use algorithmic software built on nonpublic competitor data to set rents or occupancy levels, and no one could sell or license such software to a landlord. Tenants could sue for an injunction, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees.
rules.requirement_es: Si se aprueba, los arrendadores no podrían usar software algorítmico basado en datos no públicos de competidores para fijar alquileres u ocupación, y nadie podría vender ni licenciar dicho software a un arrendador. Los inquilinos podrían demandar para obtener una orden judicial, daños o sanciones civiles de hasta $1,000 por infracción, más honorarios de abogado.
rules.quoted_span: It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords of residential rental property in the City of San Diego; excludes software that publishes reports from aggregated historical nonpublic data over 90 days old or public information, and software used to set rents under affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.exemptions: Reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or public information that do not recommend future rents; software for affordable housing program rent/income limits.
rules.effective_date_quote: This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each property is a separate violation
rules.penalty: Tenant civil action: injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; prevailing tenant recovers costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
rules.caveat: Document is a staff report with a proposed ordinance; date of final passage, adoption certification, and mayoral approval are blank, so adoption is not shown. Effective date is 30 days after final passage (unknown).
